name: vscode-tslaws
description: tsc-laws for VS Code: law highlighting, CodeLens status, diagnostics and commands

scripts.test: node --test test/grammar.test.mjs test/find-laws.test.mjs test/parse-report.test.mjs test/summary.test.mjs test/command.test.mjs test/extension.test.mjs

commands.title: tslaws: Check laws in this file
tslaws: Accept (types the command in a terminal; you press Enter)

tslaws.runOnSave.description: Run `tslaws check` after saving a TypeScript file.

tslaws.executable.description: Path of tslaws.js or a native tslaws executable (.cmd/.bat shims are refused). Empty uses the workspace's node_modules/tslaws. Machine setting: a workspace cannot set it.

tslaws.args.description: Extra arguments appended to every tslaws invocation, for example ["--compiler", "path/to/tsc"].

untrustedWorkspaces.description: tslaws runs the workspace's code (the laws and the code they check), so it does not run in an untrusted workspace.
